question: A timber-frame wall is to be insulated with the cork panel tested in the packet's laboratory report, so that the insulation alone has a thermal resistance of 2.5 m²·K/W. The panel's conductivity is the one measured after conditioning at 23 °C and 80 % relative humidity, at a mean temperature of 10 °C. What mass of oven-dry panel does one square metre of wall need?

facts.conductivity.cork.humid: the thermal conductivity of the cork panel measured after conditioning at 23 °C and 80 % relative humidity, at a mean temperature of 10 °C
facts.density.cork: the oven-dry density of the cork panel's specimens

result.description: the mass of oven-dry cork panel per square metre of wall: thermal resistance × conductivity × density
